title: Right to Rescind a Residential Natural Gas Supply Enrollment
content:
**Right.** A customer may rescind a Residential Natural Gas Supply enrollment while the agreement is still enrollment pending. The rescission is accepted only when the customer asks to rescind no later than the plan's rescission window — 10 calendar days on every plan — after the gas utility issued its enrollment confirmation (the utility confirmation date on the agreement).

**Counting.** Day one is the calendar day after the utility confirmation date, and the window closes at the end of the calendar day equal to the utility confirmation date plus 10 calendar days. The last day is included. When the utility confirmation date is still empty, the window has not started and a rescission is accepted.

**Effect.** A rescission carries no fee and no credit. Once supply has started, the agreement can only be cancelled.

**Authority.** The confirmation date is read from the company's record of the agreement concerned, not from the customer's recollection of the letter.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Utility confirmation date | Customer asks to rescind on | Day of window | Rescission |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 June | 6 June | day 1 | accepted |
| 5 June | 15 June | day 10, the closing day | accepted |
| 5 June | 16 June | day 11 | not accepted |
| empty (no confirmation yet) | any day while enrollment pending | window not started | accepted |

### Points of judgement

- The window is counted in calendar days from the confirmation date, not from the enrollment date or the service start date.
- The right exists only while the agreement is enrollment pending; an active agreement is outside it whatever the date.
